items.description: Report does not establish that a large mint or excess liquidity actually occurred before the call; it is a conditional scenario, so the excess-liquidity precondition is treated as a scenario qualifier rather than an observed fact.
The exact target buffer percentage (5%) is given only as an example, not a verified configuration; no numeric buffer value is bound.
The report does not identify which parties are authorized to call rebalanceFunds(); authorization is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a concrete role or address.
